description: Three threads drive the narrative of The Salt Room: the discovery and restoration of the tapes revealing the forgotten sister; the physical mystery of the cold room; and Nora's gradual recovery of the suppressed memory of the summer she was seven. Each thread delivers partial answers and culminates in the final chapter's choice.

threads.name: The Tapes of Della
threads.book1_resolution: Nora restores the final tape and says Della's name aloud, fully recovering the memory of her twin's drowning and the family's erasure. The central mystery is answered.
threads.book2_promise: The last tape reveals a second child's voice beneath Della's, hinting that Agnes Vance erased more than one child from the family record.
threads.book1_payoff: Emotional catharsis as Nora chooses to grieve and remember; concrete answers to the tape mystery.
threads.note: Partial concrete answers are delivered in chapters 3, 5, 7, and 9.

threads.name: The Cold Room
threads.book1_resolution: Nora understands the cold room as the physical trace of Della's erased existence—the shape of a person edited out of a family. After acknowledging Della, the room briefly warms, then goes cold again as the third voice emerges.
threads.book2_promise: The cold room reactivates with the third child's presence, setting up a new haunting.
threads.book1_payoff: Revelation of the cold room's cause; atmospheric resonance.
threads.note: The cold room is the central atmospheric symbol.

threads.name: Recovered Memory
threads.book1_resolution: Nora remembers the full truth of the summer she was seven: Della's drowning in the tidal pool, her own frozen silence, and the family's agreement to erase Della. Nora becomes whole by choosing to grieve.
threads.book2_promise: The recovered memory reveals gaps in the grandmother's history, pointing to another erased individual.
threads.book1_payoff: Nora's internal arc completes; emotional payoff from acceptance.
threads.note: Memory recovery is paced across the book, triggered by tapes and artifacts.
